elements.description:
• Administer and maintain enterprise Linux servers in production environments, ensuring high availability, optimal performance, and adherence to organizational security standards.
• Manage user lifecycle activities including account provisioning, access control, sudo privilege management, Active Directory integration, and privileged access administration through CyberArk.
• Perform storage administration tasks such as LVM management, disk provisioning and expansion, file system maintenance, NFS and NAS configuration, and troubleshooting storage-related issues.
• Monitor infrastructure health and system performance using Zabbix, proactively investigate alerts, analyze system logs, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime and improve reliability.
• Troubleshoot complex operating system, application, and infrastructure issues using log analysis tools such as journalctl and system logs, ensuring timely resolution of incidents.
• Respond to production incidents and service outages, perform root cause analysis (RCA), coordinate with cross-functional teams, and restore services within agreed SLA timelines.
• Manage Linux services and system operations using systemctl, perform package management using zypper, and execute routine maintenance activities including patching and upgrades.
• Support change management processes by implementing approved changes, validating system functionality, and ensuring minimal impact on business-critical services.

elements.description:
• Supported day-to-day Linux server administration and operational activities.
 • Managed user accounts, file systems, permissions, and service configurations.
 • Assisted in troubleshooting server, storage, and network-related issues.
 • Performed routine health checks, patching, and monitoring activities.
 • Worked on incident resolution, change requests, and service restoration tasks.

elements.description:
• Completed training on Linux Administration, Windows Server Administration, AWS Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Networking fundamentals.
• Gained hands-on experience with user management, file systems, networking concepts, and server administration tasks.
• Worked on cloud service provisioning and management exercises in AWS and Azure lab environments.
• Learned networking fundamentals including routing, switching, subnetting, and network design using Cisco Packet Tracer.
• Assisted senior engineers in monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining enterprise infrastructure environments.
• Developed understanding of ITIL processes, incident management, and change management workflows.
